title: StageDatabaseAndArchitectureCatalog
description: Comprehensive catalog of VM execution paradigms, pipeline stages, dispatch mechanisms, instruction formats, and mutation rules for generating unique multi-stage VM architectures.

stack_based.description: Pure stack machine (Forth / JVM / WASM style). Zero-address instructions.

register_based.description: Register file machine (Lua 5 / Dalvik / RISC-V style). 2 or 3-address instructions.

accumulator_based.description: Single primary accumulator register (e.g., 6502 / PDP-8). 1-address instructions.

hybrid_stack_register.description: Hybrid architecture with scratch register file backed by evaluation stack.

direct_threaded.type: Computed goto via label address array (GCC/Clang &&label syntax)

call_threaded.type: Array of function pointers called per instruction step

state_machine_pipeline.type: Discrete micro-tick state machine with explicitly yielded stages
state_machine_pipeline.overhead: Higher (optimal for asynchronous, polyhedral, and formal modeling)

invariants.name: CausalOrderPreserved
invariants.rule: For any two dependent stages S_A and S_B where S_B depends on S_A, index(S_A) < index(S_B) in active pipeline sequence.

invariants.name: SingleStateCommit
invariants.rule: STAGE_COMMIT_WRITEBACK must be strictly the last stage or followed only by dynamic pipeline mutation.

invariants.name: DataHazardFreedom
invariants.rule: STAGE_OPERAND_FETCH must complete before STAGE_EXECUTE consumes operands.

invariants.name: DecryptionBeforeDecode
invariants.rule: STAGE_DYNAMIC_DECRYPT must immediately precede STAGE_DECODE unless ciphertext format is disabled.

dataset_metadata.source: Aggregated NSA Ghidra, W3C WASM, Linux eBPF, RISC-V Foundation, and LLVM TableGen
dataset_metadata.verification_scope: opcode tables only; TLA+ modules provide the formal proofs

ghidra_pcode.description: Ghidra Universal Micro-Operations (P-Code) representing atomic ISA-independent stages

wasm_core.description: WebAssembly (W3C WASM) Staged Bytecode & Validation Taxonomy

ebpf_arch.description: Linux Kernel eBPF 64-bit Register Virtual Machine Specification

riscv_isa.description: RISC-V Formal Encoding Formats (RV32I / RV64I / Compressed RVC)

R_TYPE.description: Register-Register operations (ADD, SUB, SLL, SLT, XOR, SRL, OR, AND)

I_TYPE.description: Register-Immediate & Load operations (ADDI, ANDI, ORI, XORI, LW, LH, LB, JALR)

B_TYPE.description: Conditional Branch operations (BEQ, BNE, BLT, BGE, BLTU, BGEU)

CR_TYPE.description: Compressed 16-bit Register format (C.MV, C.ADD, C.JR, C.JALR)

CI_TYPE.description: Compressed 16-bit Immediate format (C.NOP, C.ADDI, C.LI, C.LUI)
